message.Title: Public Preview: Shard-level metrics in Azure Managed Redis

Body.Content:
Azure Managed Redis now provides shard-level metrics, giving you greater visibility into the performance of individual shards. This added granularity helps you understand workload distribution, identify potential hotspots, and troubleshoot performance more effectively. 

Learn more.
